Middelfart is a Danish municipality featured in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report evaluates the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across Denmark, breaking down data nationally, regionally, and across all 98 Danish municipalities to serve as a tool for local quality development and benchmarking in the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

Specifically, Middelfart is included in the dataset for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant (AK) treatment using DanStroke registry data [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical outcomes for this indicator are recorded in a table on page 94 of the report [^src1]. Beyond this single tabular mention detailing its stroke event metrics among atrial fibrillation patients, no further narrative details, claims, or relationships regarding Middelfart are available in the provided text.
